title: OrthoClinic Audit Log — Splunk Dashboard
description: Pre-built Splunk dashboard for OrthoClinic audit log SIEM integration (Sprint 8)

panels.title: Audit Events Over Time
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit | timechart span=1h count by action

panels.title: Top 10 Audit Actions (Last 24h)
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit earliest=-24h | top limit=10 action

panels.title: Failed Login Attempts
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action=user.login_failed | timechart span=15m count

panels.title: Patient Record Access by Actor
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action=patient.viewed | stats count by actor_id, resource_id | sort -count | head 50

panels.title: Bulk Patient Exports (LGPD Alert)
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action=patient.exported earliest=-1h | stats count

alert.message: Possible data exfiltration: {count} patient records exported in 1 hour

panels.title: Security Events
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action IN (mfa.enabled, mfa.disabled, password.changed, sso.configured, ip_allowlist.changed) | table timestamp, actor_id, actor_ip, action, resource_id | sort -timestamp

panels.title: Login Geo-Map
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action=user.login | iplocation actor_ip | geostats count by Country

panels.title: Impossible Travel Alerts
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action=user.login | streamstats current=f last(actor_ip) AS prev_ip BY actor_id | where actor_ip!=prev_ip | table timestamp, actor_id, actor_ip, prev_ip

alert.message: AUDIT LOG TAMPER DETECTED — {count} organisations with broken HMAC chains

panels.title: API Key Lifecycle Events
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action IN (api_key.created, api_key.rotated, api_key.revoked) | table timestamp, actor_id, action, resource_id | sort -timestamp | head 100

panels.title: Admin Configuration Changes
panels.search: index=orthoclinic sourcetype=audit action IN (org.settings_changed, webhook.created, ip_allowlist.changed) | table timestamp, actor_id, actor_ip, action, organization_id, resource_id | sort -timestamp

hec_config.comment: Configure Splunk HEC to receive from OrthoClinic SIEM_WEBHOOK_URL

datadog_config.comment: For Datadog Logs, set SIEM_WEBHOOK_URL to the Datadog log intake

elastic_config.comment: For Elastic SIEM, use Elastic Agent or the Elasticsearch ingest API

sentinel_config.comment: For Microsoft Sentinel, enable CEF syslog forwarding
sentinel_config.syslog_forward: rsyslog → Azure Monitor Agent → Log Analytics Workspace
